finding.title: The use of std::cout to print the email body could potentially be problematic if the email content is influenced by user input.
Similar to CWE-78, this issue is more relevant if the email content were to be influenced by user input.
Although this code does not generate a web page, if the email content were to be displayed in a web application, this could be a concern.
The use of memcpy without proper bounds checking could lead to a buffer overflow if the email_data->size is manipulated.
Similar to CWE-120, this issue is more relevant if the buffer size is not properly managed.
